x: The senior match also included several field events and here our men did quite well, considering the strong opposition. In the Shot Putt our new member, L.
Jones had an excellent win in the Shot Putt with 39ft. 1in.—the best performance yet in Club events by "home" talent—only Grassau and Pfenninger having beaten it. L.
We had the first two in the Shot Putt with S. Jones and L.
Sid Jones came out best with an effort of 39ft. 1in. L.
Watts won the 440 Yards for us, while Charlie Melchior threw 169 ft. 10 ins. to win the Javelin Throw. The Weight and Discus were won by L.
